title: Engineering weekly tactical brief — 2026-03-17
content:
Date: 2026-03-17
Attendees: Ava M (chair), Ravi P, Mina K, Luis O, Sofia N, Ethan B, product liaisons: T. Harris, K. Alvarez (partial)
Duration: 45 minutes

Objective: Short tactical sync across platform, serving runtime, private deployments, and release engineering. Surface immediate blockers, align on SLA mitigations, and confirm owners for carryover actions.

Top-level summary/decisions:
- Agreement to hold a controlled canary for the kernel-scheduler change next Tue (2026-03-24) limited to internal Dedicated clusters; rollback plan must be staged and tested by Wed. Owner: Ravi.
- Temporary autoscale cap increased for Dedicated by +20% for two weeks to absorb promotional traffic. Finance okay with one-off bump. Owner: Mina to update autoscale policy and notify sales.
- Private deployment onboarding checklist updated; two mandatory steps added (networking audit and KMS verification). Luis to push checklist into onboarding repo by end of week.

Round-robin updates (3–4 bullets each):
- Serving Runtime (Ravi)
  - Kernel-scheduler patch showing 8–12% tail-latency improvement in dev; some memory regression on seq_len>8 workloads — reproducing on a p4d repro.
  - Action: run repro on p4d-canary with KV-cache disabled to isolate; target 2026-03-19 for initial results.
  - Risk: if memory regression persists, delay canary and open opt-in experiment for power-users.

- Platform / Orchestration (Mina)
  - Autoscaling policy change in staging completed; performance test shows stable utilization at +15% load.
  - Workload routing rule for cost-tiering (route to quantized variant at >500ms predicted latency) prototype ready — needs product sign-off.
  - Action: coordinate with Product (K. Alvarez) for rollout checklist by 2026-03-22.

- Private Deployments (Luis)
  - Onboarding: two active pilots scheduled (healthtech and fintech customers) — both require stricter SOC2 artifact export.
  - Added mandatory network audit + KMS key rotation verification to onboarding doc.
  - Blocker: one pilot needs HSM integration earlier than planned — SOW change requested. Luis to escalate to PS and Sales.

- Release Engineering (Sofia)
  - Canary automation improvements: auto-promote only after three successful health checks (was 1).
  - Manual holdpoints added for model-variant promotions to Dedicated clusters.
  - Action: update release playbook and run a dry-run next Thursday.

- Observability / SRE (Ethan)
  - Alert noise reduced: re-tuned anomaly detector for token-per-second on busy routes; reduced false positives by ~30%.
  - Investigating an uptick in 503s on region-eu-west for the embeddings endpoint — hypothesis: transient LB misconfig during maintenance window.
  - Action: correlate LB logs with deployment schedule, report back by 2026-03-18.

Cross-team items / blockers:
- Incident follow-up from last week (ID: JIRA-4821): postmortem draft circulated; two outstanding remediation items (retry backoff tuning + client-side rate-limiting guidance). Owners: Ethan (server), Product docs (K. Alvarez). Due: 2026-03-24.
- Hiring update: platform infra hiring slowed — ask for contractor budget to fill gap for next 3 months. HR loop: Ava will confirm headcount runway and propose contractor plan in next exec sync.
- Evals / Quality monitoring: Redwood Optimize team flagged a regression in re-ranking quality after quantization on one model family. Research to provide a short A/B plan for canarying quantized variants. Owner: Mina + Research (S. Li).

Open questions / discussion notes (notes-to-self tone preserved):
- Do we need a separate SLO for Dedicated latency vs hosted? Product leaning yes, ops says would complicate routing. Follow-up: plan short doc comparing two SLO models (Ava to sketch).
- How to surface 'quality vs cost' tradeoffs in Console for customers? Suggest prototype widget showing cost delta + expected quality delta; product to scope.

Action items with owners and dates:
- Ravi: Run memory-regression repro on p4d-canary with KV-cache off and report 2026-03-19.
- Mina: Push autoscale policy change and notify Sales + update routing policy doc by 2026-03-22.
- Luis: Publish updated onboarding checklist (network audit + KMS verification) to onboarding repo by 2026-03-20 and escalate HSM requirement with PS.
- Sofia: Update release playbook with new holdpoints and run dry-run 2026-03-24.
- Ethan: Correlate LB logs with maintenance windows and post findings 2026-03-18.
- Ava: Draft SLO comparison doc for Dedicated vs Hosted and circulate 2026-03-23.
- Mina + S. Li: Create A/B plan for quantized re-ranking canary 2026-03-21.

Decisions to record:
- Proceed with limited internal canary for kernel-scheduler next Tue pending repro verification and rollback test.
- Increase autoscale caps temporarily for Dedicated; review impact after two-week window.

Risks / mitigation notes:
- Kernel memory regression: mitigation = KV-cache toggle + staged canary on limited clusters, revert path defined.
- HSM requirement for pilot: may delay delivery; mitigation = short-term HSM emulator or add SOW amendment for vendor integration.
- Cost creep from autoscale bump: finance to monitor and cap spend; require explicit approval if exceed projected thresholds.

Misc / FYI / links mentioned in discussion:
- Runtime perf dashboard: /dashboards/runtime-latency (internal)
- Canary checklist: CONFLUENCE-1234
- Incident JIRA: JIRA-4821

Next meeting: standard cross-team engineering leadership staff sync, Tue 2026-03-24 10:00-10:45 (tentative) — primary agenda: kernel canary report, autoscale impact review, private pilot HSM decision.

Notes: document is a working brief — will be copied to CONFLUENCE under /pages/platform/weekly-tactical and linked to the relevant Jira tasks.

End of brief.
